newsitem.title: USA: Holder urges Price to revisit Palmer deal.
newsitem.headline: Holder urges Price to revisit Palmer deal.

text.p: Franklin Associates Inc said Wednesday it was concerned about terms of the acquisition of Palmer Wireless Inc by Price Communications Corp, saying Price may need to "reexamine" the merits of the deal.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, FAI said the purchase price and the proposed funding of this transaction, primarily through debt financing, may not be consistent with the maximization of shareholder value.
FAI said Price should reexamine the merits of the transaction and "explore other avenues for achieving the greatest value for its shareholders."
FAI, an investment adviser, is a unit of Franklin Resources Inc. A group led by Franklin Resources holds a 31.5 percent stake in Price or 2,291,953 common shares.
On May 23, Price had announced it reached a definitive agreement to acquire Palmer for $17.50 per share in cash and an aggregate purchase price of about $880 million, including the repayment of debt.
